newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metrobank '96 net 5.003 bln pesos - Angping.
newsitem.headline: Metrobank '96 net 5.003 bln pesos - Angping.

text.p: Angping & Associates Securities Inc said on Tuesday Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co had an unaudited net income of 5.003 billion in 1996 from 3.501 billion pesos in 1995.
The bank had said it will release the official results on Wednesday.
Giving the bank's results in a report to clients, Angping said the growth in earnings was due to a 42.8 percent growth in loans and a 13 percent increase in other income.

The securities firm said net loans of Metrobank expanded to 119.731 billion pesos in 1996 from 83.864 billion pesos in 1995, while deposits swelled by 35.3 percent to 132.05 billion pesos from 97.6 billion pesos.
Angping computed the bank's net interest margin had improved to 4.8 percent from 4.3 percent due to the lower cost of funding.
Assets rose 25.8 percent to 201.554 billion pesos from 160.265 billion. Capital jumped 19.7 percent to 26.975 billion pesos from 22.536 billion, Angping said.
"Metrobank remains our top pick in the banking sector," Angping said, adding that it projected the bank's profits to grow 37 percent to 6.847 billion pesos in 1997.
A Reuter poll of six brokerages earlier this month showed the bank was expected to post net profit of 4.945 billion pesos in 1996 versus the year-earlier figure of 3.5 billion pesos.

A bank official told Reuters two weeks ago the bank was expected to report a net income of a "little over" five billion pesos in 1996. The bank is aiming for net income of seven billion pesos in 1997.
